title: RTSM: Adapting Recursive Models to Multivariate Time-Series Classification
abstract: arXiv:2610.23353v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Accurate multivariate time-series classification requires extracting temporal features and integrating information across a sequence. Weight-tied refinement offers a way to repeatedly process these features without allocating new parameters at each stage. Applying this principle to time series requires choosing both a temporal representation and a latent-state organization suited to classification. We introduce the Recursive Time-Series Model (RTSM), which combines a learned convolutional temporal tokenizer, single-state weight-tied refinement, and a pooled classification readout. Across all 30 UEA datasets, RTSM achieves 72.81% mean accuracy under validation-based configuration and checkpoint selection, the highest observed mean among the 17 evaluated deep-learning models and 1.60 percentage points above MambaSL. translated_title: RTSM：将递归模型适配到多元时间序列分类
translated_abstract: 准确的多元时间序列分类需要提取时间特征并整合整个序列中的信息。权重共享迭代精炼提供了一种重复处理这些特征而无需在每个阶段分配新参数的方法。将这一原理应用于时间序列，需要同时选择适合分类的时间表示形式和潜在状态组织方式。我们提出递归时间序列模型（RTSM），它结合了可学习的卷积时间分词器、单状态权重共享精炼机制以及池化分类读出层。在全部30个UEA数据集上，RTSM在基于验证集的配置与检查点选择下取得了72.81%的平均准确率，这是所评估的17个深度学习模型中最高的平均准确率，比MambaSL高出1.60个百分点。在八个数据集上的消融实验表明，所提出的分词器优于简单的卷积嵌入，单状态模型优于（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: RTSM通过结合可学习的卷积时间分词器、单状态权重共享精炼和池化分类读出，在30个UEA多元时间序列分类数据集上取得72.81%的平均准确率，在17个深度学习模型中排名第一。
en_tdlr: RTSM combines a learned convolutional temporal tokenizer, single-state weight-tied refinement, and pooled classification readout, achieving a 72.81% mean accuracy across all 30 UEA datasets, the highest among 17 evaluated deep-learning models.
